entries.logic: Uses final classes with private constructors to store application-wide strings and settings. Prevents instantiation.
entries.implementation: public final class Constants { private Constants(){} public static final String NAME = "..."; }
entries.rationale: Ensures a type-safe and non-instantiable way to manage global configuration, adhering to clean code standards.

entries.logic: Isolates the version string in a dedicated Version class. This simplifies automated updates and build metadata extraction.
entries.implementation: public final class Version { public static final String VERSION = "0.1.0"; }
entries.rationale: Decouples version tracking from business logic, facilitating CI/CD integration and release management.
